summary: Validated all new orchestrator / heartbeat / wiki APIs and the three new UIs (Devin-style workbench, Claude-style command, Obsidian-style wiki). 16/16 backend tests pass and the three pages all render with the required data-testids; wiki note create+save flow works end-to-end. Two minor issues found: (1) /api/heartbeat/sweep is blocked by middleware so the 'no-auth-unless-CRON_SECRET' contract is actually unreachable from outside a logged-in browser; (2) React warning 'two children with the same key' on wiki vault tree when duplicate slugs exist.

minor.issue: Route docstring says 'no auth required unless CRON_SECRET set', but /app/middleware.ts gates ALL /api/* (except /api/auth, /api/public, /api/health) behind a session cookie. So an external cron/curl with only Bearer CRON_SECRET will get 401 from middleware before the route checks the bearer. Either add '/api/heartbeat/sweep' to middleware's skip list or document that this route is only callable from inside the app.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' when two notes share the same slug/path (e.g. running the backend tests twice creates two 'TEST_Strategy Doc' entries). Use note.id (or path+id) as the React key instead of slug/title.

action_items: Either expose /api/heartbeat/sweep to the middleware allow-list (so Bearer CRON_SECRET can call it) or update the route's docstring to make it explicit that it must be triggered from an authenticated context.
Fix duplicate-key React warning in obsidian-wiki-client.tsx vault tree by keying on note.id (not slug/title).
Backend test created TEST_-prefixed wiki notes; the in-memory store retains them across reloads (globalThis). Consider periodic cleanup or a teardown DELETE pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Middleware allow-list is too aggressive for cron-style endpoints: /api/heartbeat/sweep claims to support bearer-token cron auth but middleware blocks it.
Wiki tree key collisions: when two notes have the same path, the UI silently duplicates them and React warns. The buildWikiTree() output and the renderer should disambiguate on note.id.

Orchestrator GET response shape is consistent ({ run: { id, status, steps[] } }), planner produced a 6-step DAG with role badges (analyst/content/support/engineer/finance/ceo) within ~8s — works as advertised.
Wiki note POST correctly parses [[Vision]] as outgoing link (shown as orange 'create' chip) and #strategy/#q1/#ui-test as tags.
Bridge /v1/chat/completions returns proper OpenAI shape with non-empty choices[0].message.content.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 pytest cases passing after sweep test was adjusted to use the same authenticated session the middleware demands)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the three pages tested (workbench, command, wiki) — all required data-testids present and the wiki create-save flow persisted via API

test_credentials: demo@trent.app via NextAuth credentials provider (POST /api/auth/callback/credentials with csrfToken). No password.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created TEST_-prefixed wiki notes ('TEST_Strategy Doc', 'TEST_UI_NOTE', plus a /uploads/test-upload.md). One was deleted by the delete test; the rest survive in the in-memory store across hot reloads (globalThis). Also created one orchestration run + one heartbeat report.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_trent_backend.py. Auth flow uses session.post('/api/auth/callback/credentials', data={csrfToken, email, json:'true'}). All /api/* routes (except /api/auth, /api/public, /api/health) are gated by /app/middleware.ts and need a session cookie — keep this in mind when testing 'cron' endpoints. Orchestrator run completion takes 3–5 min; tests assert progress within 60s only.
rca of the issue: Heartbeat sweep RCA: The route handler at /app/app/api/heartbeat/sweep/route.ts implements optional Bearer-token auth (cron pattern), but /app/middleware.ts has a blanket rule that returns 401 JSON for any /api/* path without a NextAuth session cookie. Order of execution: middleware runs first, so the route's CRON_SECRET check is unreachable when called without a session. Mitigation: add 'pathname.startsWith("/api/heartbeat/sweep")' to the public-skip block in middleware.ts, or move the route under /api/public/heartbeat/sweep.
